worked.problem: An L-shaped card is a 9 cm by 7 cm rectangle with a 3 cm by 2 cm corner removed. Find its area and outside perimeter.
actions: Draw the outer 9 cm × 7 cm rectangle and mark the removed 3 cm × 2 cm corner.
Outer area = 9 × 7 = 63 cm²; removed area = 3 × 2 = 6 cm².
Subtract only the removed region: A = 63 − 6 = 57 cm².
Trace the six outside boundary segments; the two added notch edges replace the two lost corner edges, so P = 2(9 + 7) = 32 cm.
worked.misconception: Keep the given lengths and units attached to the correct edges; perimeter counts boundary length, area counts square units.
